title: 11 Best Birria in Guadalajara (2026)
description: The best birria in Guadalajara, Mexico — curated from Reddit reviews and local food blogs. Goat, beef, and pork birria from legendary birrierías. Interactive map included.

places.name: Birriería Las 9 Esquinas

redditQuotes.text: Some of the absolutely best Birria I've had. The meat was such good quality, still has some red to it, no need to be overcooked.
Maybe some birria from Las 9 Esquinas.
redditQuotes.source: — r/Guadalajara · top unmissable places to eat downtown

redditQuotes.text: I have a pic from that exact same place. I ordered a regular plato de birria. Really awesome food there in Guadalajara.

places.verdict: The most famous birriería in Guadalajara — and it lives up to the hype. Sitting in this simple restaurant overlooking the historic plaza, dipping tortillas into that dark, spice-laden consomé, you understand why this dish defines a city.

comparison.best for: First-time birria experience in Guadalajara's most historic setting
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 13,307 reviews · Open 8 AM–9 PM daily · Central location · Full menu
comparison.limitations: Can be touristy at peak hours; locals debate whether it's truly the "best"
comparison.what to order: Plato de birria de chivo (goat) with consomé. Ask for extra tortillas and a side of beans with queso fresco. The tacos dorados de birria are excellent too.

places.name: Birriería Chololo

redditQuotes.text: Birria el Chololo seems like the most famous place for birria based on my research. Do locals also consider them as the best?
redditQuotes.source: — r/Guadalajara · Korean tourist planning birria trip

redditQuotes.text: Chololo has a really good birria and complements.

places.verdict: The local institution. Chololo is to Guadalajara birria what Franklin is to Austin BBQ — the spot that defines the standard. They use only goat, serve on clay plates from adobe ovens, and go through 200 kg of meat per day. Sundays are a full experience with live music, tequila, and 600+ seats.

comparison.best for: The definitive traditional goat birria experience
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ · Goat only · Adobe tatemado ovens · Clay plates · Live music Sundays
comparison.limitations: 20 min from downtown; original highway location can be hard to reach by taxi
comparison.what to order: Mixed plate (plato surtido) — you get different cuts of goat including ribs and leg. Meat and broth served separately. Add beans and a tequila from their curated selection.

places.whatToOrder: Mixed plate (plato surtido) — you get different cuts of goat including ribs and leg. Meat and broth served separately. Add beans and a tequila from their curated selection.

places.name: Birriería La Victoria

redditQuotes.text: Birriería la Victoria has been serving food since 1948. This particular birria is a favorite of local celebrity chefs like Paco Ruano.

places.verdict: Open since 1948, La Victoria is a living time capsule of old Guadalajara. The walls are covered with vintage newspaper clippings, and celebrity chefs like Paco Ruano count it as a favorite. The goat birria comes out of the tatemado oven perfectly crispy — ask for it "bien doradito."

comparison.strengths: 4.6★ · 75+ years of history · Celebrity chef endorsed · Tatemado oven on display
comparison.limitations: Closes at 5 PM; small venue can fill up at peak hours
comparison.what to order: Mixed goat birria "bien doradito" (extra crispy). Get a side of beans and spread them on your tortillas. The mild ranchero salsa is great; the chile de árbol salsa is very spicy.

places.whatToOrder: Mixed goat birria "bien doradito" (extra crispy). Get a side of beans and spread them on your tortillas. The mild ranchero salsa is great; the chile de árbol salsa is very spicy.

places.name: Birriería Aceves

redditQuotes.text: Tucked into an unassuming pathway of Guadalajara's wholesale market, Birriería Aceves has been an important part of the market since it opened in the 1960's. Rich, poor, it doesn't matter who you are, everyone has to stand in line.

places.verdict: Hidden inside Guadalajara's massive wholesale market since the 1960s, Aceves is the birriería that market workers line up for. Rich, poor, it doesn't matter — everyone waits in the same line. They sell out early, the handmade tortillas are the best in the city, and the taco de gordito dipped in consomé is a religious experience.

comparison.best for: Authentic market experience with Guadalajara's highest-rated birria

comparison.limitations: Sells out by early afternoon; closed Wednesdays; small and crowded; no website
comparison.what to order: Goat or veal birria with a taco de gordito on the side — dip it in the consomé. Their handmade corn tortillas are exceptional.

places.name: Birriería David

redditQuotes.text: I duck into the labyrinthian complex of my final destination, the Mercado Alcalde, and soon find myself in a sprawling food court.

places.verdict: David and his son have been in the birria business for 50+ years. While there are other birrierías in Mercado Alcalde's food court, locals wait in line for David's while the others sit empty. His veal birria is crispy from the tatemado oven, the broth is impossibly clean, and the machito (tripe-wrapped liver) is the mildest you'll find.

comparison.best for: Crispy veal birria with the cleanest broth in town
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ · 50+ years · Cleanest broth · Best machito · Market atmosphere
comparison.limitations: Closes 2-3 PM; no sodas — get pineapple juice from the other side of the market
comparison.what to order: Veal birria from the tatemado oven. Try the machito if you're adventurous — it's mild here. Grab a fresh pineapple juice from a nearby vendor.

places.name: Karne Garibaldi
places.verdict: While technically famous for carne en su jugo (beef in its juices with bacon and beans), Karne Garibaldi holds a Guinness World Record for fastest service — your food arrives within 13 seconds of ordering. With 32,000+ Google reviews and a 4.6 rating, this is Guadalajara's most-reviewed restaurant. The birria-adjacent experience is unmissable.

comparison.limitations: Not traditional birria — carne en su jugo is a different (related) dish
comparison.what to order: Carne en su jugo — beef in broth with bacon, beans, and fresh toppings. The chica (small) portion is usually enough. Add their house salsa.

places.name: La Panga del Impostor
places.address: C. Miguel Lerdo de Tejada 2189, Colonia Americana

redditQuotes.text: The natural sweetness of the seafood contrasts perfectly with the savory broth. It's so good I suck on the clam shell in order to get at every last bit of flesh.
For me birria is the perfect morning food for a hangover. I'm happy that it's getting so popular these days outside of Mexico.
redditQuotes.source: — Ivan Ibarra, head chef at La Panga · Condé Nast Traveler

places.verdict: The wildcard on this list. La Panga is a hip outdoor seafood restaurant in Colonia Americana that serves birria de almeja — a twist on the classic using clam and shrimp in beef birria broth. Featured in Condé Nast Traveler's birria guide, it's where tradition meets creativity. They also bring in proper Cocula-style goat and pork birria from a chef's hometown.

comparison.strengths: 4.4★ · Condé Nast Traveler featured · Unique seafood birria · Cool neighborhood
comparison.limitations: Opens at 1 PM (not for breakfast birria); pricier than traditional spots
comparison.what to order: Birria de almeja (clam birria) — clam and shrimp in beef birria broth. Also try the goat birria from Cocula if available. Pair with a Corona.

places.name: Birriería Cocula

redditQuotes.text: Birrieria Cocula brings birria to the big city in the style of the dish's true hometown, which includes the hard-to-find birria de cerdo (pork).

places.verdict: Named after the town that claims to be birria's true birthplace, Birriería Cocula brings the Cocula style to Guadalajara — including the rare birria de cerdo (pork). If you've only had goat and beef birria, the pork version is a revelation: buttery, tender, and a completely different experience. Featured in Condé Nast Traveler.

comparison.limitations: Closed Mondays; slightly off the tourist trail in Mezquitan
comparison.what to order: Birria de cerdo (pork) — it's their specialty and hard to find elsewhere. Compare it with their goat version for the full experience.

places.name: El Cortijo Taco de Birria
places.address: Calle Gral. Eulogio Parra 2437, Ladrón de Guevara
places.verdict: If you want birria tacos specifically — not a bowl of stew — El Cortijo is the spot. Recommended by Condé Nast Traveler for their "mouthwatering birria tacos," this no-frills joint in Ladrón de Guevara is the cheapest spot on this list and one of the highest-rated.

comparison.limitations: Tacos only — no full birria plates; closes at 4 PM
comparison.what to order: Tacos de birria — order several. Dip them in the consomé. Simple, cheap, perfect.

places.name: Birria El Güero
places.verdict: Off the tourist radar in the Talpita neighborhood, El Güero is where locals go for everyday birria. Opens at 7:30 AM, closes by mid-afternoon, and has a 4.6 rating from nearly 840 reviews — all from locals. No English menu, no tourist infrastructure, just honest birria at honest prices.

comparison.limitations: Far from tourist areas; Spanish only; closes early on weekends
comparison.what to order: Whatever they're serving that day — El Güero keeps it simple. Birria plate with tortillas, beans, and all the fixings.

places.name: Plaza de las 9 Esquinas (Other Birrierías)
places.address: Plaza de las 9 Esquinas, Zona Centro

redditQuotes.text: La Plaza de las Nueve Esquinas is one of the most picturesque places to begin your birria tasting tour. Located in the historic core of Guadalajara.

places.verdict: Beyond Las 9 Esquinas restaurant (#1), the entire plaza is a birria district with multiple vendors surrounding the oddly-shaped intersection. Each has their own loyal following. It's the most picturesque place to start a birria tasting tour — walk the square, peek into each spot, and pick the one that calls to you. Great for breakfast before a downtown walking tour.
